notes.title: 1.0 is Finally Here!
notes.content:
[h1]TP Royale is now complete![/h1]
Enjoy the brand new multiplayer modes with your friends.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1288130/TP_Royale/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1288130/ss_6a312ec51733ba92ee6215caa6b33110c1990cb4.1920x1080.jpg?t=1604152222[/img][/url]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Upgraded to 1.0
[*] Added several new levels
[*] Multiplayer support added
[*] Multiplayer [b]5G Nightmare[/b] mode added
[*] Multiplayer [b]Capture the TP[/b] mode added
[*] Fixed issue where the music volume slider did nothing
[*] Fixed issue where taser light wouldn't go away
[*] Fixed issue where players couldn't get up after respawning
[*] Added music to the main menu
[/list]

[h3]What comes next though?[/h3]
 I'll be moving onto a new project. Hopefully one that gets a lot more attention.
TP Royale has been a blast to work on, but it's time to move on to bigger and better games.

[h2]Thank you all for your support during the early access period![/h2]

notes.title: Fourth of July Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Fourth of July![/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1288130/TP_Royale/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1288130/ss_afa80de211d60d1b9afd1e7c9f4a2da703469626.1920x1080.jpg?t=1593873116[/img][/url]

[h2]So what did you add?[/h2]
We added a new [b]Firework Show[/b] at the back of Superstore that you can watch all night long.
We also added a new [b]Firework Gun[/b] for you to have fun with.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where taser impacting invisible collider on characters
[*] Fixed audio bug with taser
[*] Added Special Event to main menu.
[*] Added Firework Gun
[*] Updated Superstore Level
[/list]

Stay safe out there!

- TP Team

notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added simple tutorial in [b]Quickshop[/b] level for new players.
[*] Fixed bug where you can punch after collecting an item.
[*] Fixed lighting in [b]Neon Parkour[/b] levels.
[*] Lowered spawn rate of collectibles.
[*] Added more details to [b]Costlows[/b] level.
[/list]

[h2]This is okay, but what comes next?[/h2]
We're hard at work on more features, so stay tuned.
We'll be making more announcements accordingly regarding those new features.

- TP Team

notes.title: Early Access is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Early Access is here at last![/h2]
TP Royale is finally on Early Access. We're looking forward to more updates and further improvements including multiplayer eventually!

[h2]What to expect?[/h2]
The initial Early Access Release contains several skins to unlock, over 15 levels, and the experience you've been waiting for.

[h2]What comes next?[/h2]
We look forward to adding more content and modes including multiplayer in the near future. So stay tuned!

notes.title: Only 10 Days Until Release!
notes.content:
[h2]What to expect on release:[/h2]
The early access release will include all of the features listed on the store page.

[b]- Multiple Story Levels
- Weapons
- Character Skins
- Parkour Challenges[/b]

[h2]But...What about multiplayer?[/h2]
Multiplayer will come sometime after the release. Yes we know you want it. We're doing our best. So hang in there.

[h2]So is that all?[/h2]
Of course not! We have many ideas for the game that we'll be adding during the early access phase.

[h2]How long will it be in Early Access?[/h2]
We expect that it will take 2-3 months to get every feature we want into the game. So expect regular updates until then!

See you in 10 Days!

- TP Team

notes.title: About the Delay
notes.content:
[h1]Sorry for the delay![/h1]
Unfortunately we lost some progress when our current project became corrupted and we were set back. Due to the progress we lost, we believe that the game won't be at an acceptable state on the original release date.

We should be ready to release again in early June.

- TP Team
